name: imprnt-plugin-whenful
description: imprnt plugin: a local mirror of your Whenful tasks, rendered at read. Keeps task state in its own folder; never edits a vault note.

scripts.build: bun build src/check.ts --target=node --outfile=check.js --banner '#!/usr/bin/env node' && bun build src/whenful.ts --target=node --outfile=whenful.js --banner '#!/usr/bin/env node'

author: Aleksandr Bogdanov
